title: Recorded grammar and metamodel deviations
description: Replaces the prose PATCHES.md. Structured so scripts/grammar_diff.py can tell reviewed differences from unreviewed ones without grepping markdown, and so the spec-conformance-reviewer can check citations mechanically.

source_selection.description: Which grammar was vendored, why, and what was known about its defects going in.

production.description: Name as it appears in productions.json

upstream.description: What the Xtext does as shipped

problem.description: The input it gets wrong, concretely

evidence.description: At least one. A clause citation retrieved from the wiki, or a corpus file path.

unpatched.description: Places upstream is wrong and we have chosen NOT to diverge. These matter as much as the patches — they are what a reader would otherwise assume had been handled.
